citations.assessment: The retrieved Yerushalmi puts ye’ut before hava and the named subject. It functions adverbially with the contention, and the segment gives no Yaut byname.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

notes.text: The exact word order supports treating ye’ut as an adverb. The existing provisional note remains part of the record.
